assertion: An event exists, described as "2026 World Cup Final between Argentina and Spain".
judge_quote: Argentina lose World Cup final to Spain
evidence_cited: Lionel Messi could have ended all debate over who is the greatest player of all time by winning another World Cup with Argentina on Sunday, but he was left in tears following Spain's 1-0 win.
Ten-man Argentina did not lay a glove on Spain at the MetLife Stadium, and were lucky to survive until the 106th minute, when Ferran Torres finally broke the deadlock.

assertion: An event exists, described as "2016 Copa America Centenario Final".
judge_quote: when he came to the MetLife Stadium for the Copa America Centenario decider against Chile in 2016
evidence_cited: The final passed Messi by, and as he broke down in tears it was easy to think that he might have been much better off bowing out on that glorious night in Doha in 2022.
But this time he emulated his legendary predecessor in a different way.
Argentina failed to become the first team to retain the World Cup since Brazil in 1962, but this was still a momentous day for Messi.
He became only the second player to appear in three World Cup finals, matching the achievement of Brazil great Cafu.
He went on to enjoy an incredible late career revival with his country, winning the Copa America back-to-back in 2021 and 2024, either side of the 2022 World Cup.
